cases.key: A second ACB handle (player type 0, for the URI engine) is created at every boot whatever the viewer's playback engine, instead of only when the Experimental engine is first offered a play; on webOS 4.4 every Feed Load then times out.
SDL_webOSCursorVisibility is now looked up at runtime and is absent on webOS 3.x's SDL 2.0.4, so hide_cursor() silently does nothing there and the pointer stays on screen, over video too.
Catalan is added as a shipped language without its entry in tools/hud_preview.py's LONG_TITLES corpus, so the HUD preview matrix refuses to plan.

The session owner's cache refill now runs on any app frame, and under Resources::Fixture SessionAdapter::begin_cache_refresh still submits a real storage-worker job, so fixture Bridge tests receive a CacheRefreshed on a timing-dependent frame and can read a developer's real auth.json.
The release spring of a card whose hold the app took is reported by Press::tick as page damage, so under an open item menu the frozen host snapshot is re-captured on every frame of the spring.
The pull request removes the nightly toolchain but leaves .claude/settings.json's permission allowlist naming `cargo +nightly check`, so the documented release check no longer matches it and prompts.
